source.text: Participants in dose escalation or supplemental cohorts must have histologically proven unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic solid tumor limited to one of the following types: NSCLC adenocarcinoma, cholangiocarcinoma, colorectal carcinoma (CRC), or pancreatic carcinoma
